records.name: Amy Kremenek
records.notes: 5th President of TC3, started June 1, 2022. Under her tenure core enrollment grew 14% since 2021 and TC3 joined the Achieving the Dream consortium in 2025.

records.name: Orinthia T. Montague
records.notes: 4th President of TC3. Left to become president of Volunteer State Community College (TN).

records.name: Carl E. Haynes
records.notes: 3rd President of TC3, longest presidency in college history (23 years); now President Emeritus. Oversaw campus expansion (~90,000 sq ft) and construction of a solar plant.

records.name: Eduardo J. Marti
records.notes: 2nd President of TC3. Later served as president of Queensborough Community College and interim president of Bronx Community College.

records.name: Hushang Bahar
records.notes: Founding President; led TC3 from opening (180 students) through growth to 5,000+ students annually.

records.name: Jesse Ulrich
records.notes: Current president, confirmed via Wikipedia infobox and a 2026 news photo caption identifying him at a Workforce Pell grant event with Iowa Gov. Kim Reynolds. The college's official website (iowacentral.edu) returned repeated server errors during this research and could not be accessed to confirm start date, prior role, or predecessor; no qualifying news coverage of his appointment was found.

records.name: Garrett D. Hinshaw
records.notes: Current president, began August 1, 2006. Only the third president in CVCC's 60+ year history.

records.name: Cuyler A. Dunbar
records.notes: Second president of CVCC, served 1987-2006.

records.name: Robert Paap
records.notes: Founding president of CVCC; retired in 1987.

records.name: Scott Williams
records.notes: Current Chancellor of OCTC (KCTCS colleges use the title 'Chancellor' rather than 'President'). The college's leadership page describes him only as 'an educator with a wide variety of academic and real world experience'; start date, prior role, and predecessor could not be confirmed - the site's About/history pages and available news searches did not surface this information.

records.name: Timothy (Tim) Stokes
records.notes: Current president, confirmed on SPSCC's leadership page. Start date, prior role, and predecessor could not be confirmed - the site's bio page and available news searches did not surface those details.

records.name: Keith Cornille
records.priorTitle: Executive Vice President/Chief Student Services Officer (18 years)
records.notes: Current president since July 2018; also held prior leadership roles at Indiana University-Southeast, College of DuPage, and Richard J. Daley College. Past Chair of the Illinois Community College Council of Presidents.

records.name: Rob Widmer
records.notes: Preceded Cornille; retired in 2018. Exact start year not confirmed.

records.name: Allen Goben
records.notes: Succeeded founding president Jonathan Astroth; served between Astroth (through 2010) and Widmer. Specific dates not available.

records.name: Jonathan Astroth
records.notes: Heartland's first (founding) president, 1991-2010. The Astroth Community Education Center is named in his honor.

records.name: Gayle Pitman
records.priorTitle: Vice President of Institutional Equity, Effectiveness and Success
records.notes: Selected by the Board of Trustees (vote scheduled April 30, 2026) and began as Superintendent/President July 1, 2026, succeeding Torence Powell. Confirmed also via Santa Rosa Press Democrat (https://www.pressdemocrat.com/2026/05/27/napa-valley-college-approves-contract-for-new-superintendent-and-president/).

records.name: Torence Powell
records.notes: Resigned as Napa Valley College Superintendent-President earlier in 2026 to become Chancellor of the Los Rios Community College District (Sacramento), creating the vacancy Pitman filled. Exact start year at Napa Valley College not confirmed.

records.name: Jonathan Eldridge
records.priorTitle: Assistant Superintendent/Vice President for Student Learning & Success
records.notes: 11th Superintendent/President of College of Marin. Joined the college in 2013 as VP before being elevated to the presidency (start year approximate; not independently confirmed via news archive during this research). Previously held roles at the University of Washington, Lewis & Clark College (Dean of Students), and Southern Oregon University (VP for Student Affairs).

records.name: David Wain Coon
records.notes: Predecessor to Eldridge; the college's new student center is named the 'David Wain Coon Center for Student Success' in his honor, confirming his prior presidency. Specific tenure dates not confirmed.

records.name: Ken Ingle
records.notes: Current president per the college's official 'Message from the President' page. Start date, prior role, and predecessor could not be confirmed - news searches for his appointment returned no results during this research.

records.name: Dave Dahms
records.priorTitle: Vice President of Finance and Administration; then Acting President
records.notes: Currently serving as Interim President; the NICC Board of Trustees elevated him from VP of Finance and Administration to Acting President and then formally to Interim President while a search for a permanent president continues. Predecessor's identity and departure circumstances not confirmed via available sources.

records.name: Primavera Monarrez
records.notes: Confirmed as Interim President - both the college's own 'President's Message' page and news search results (referencing an article on record enrollment growth) identify her as interim. The label in the source list ('Office of the Interim President') is accurate as of this research. Appointment date and predecessor could not be confirmed.

records.name: Jacqueline W. Kineavy
records.notes: Serving as Interim President following the sudden death of longtime president Steven M. Rose in early 2026. PCCC has an active presidential search underway (applications due September 8, 2026; announcement anticipated November 2026; new president expected to start January 2027).

records.name: Steven M. Rose
records.notes: Served as PCCC president for approximately 30 years; died in office in early 2026 ('N.J. college mourns death of its president of 30 years'). PCCC's website includes an 'In Memory of Dr. Rose' tribute. Exact start year not confirmed.

records.name: Stacey J. Moore
records.notes: Current president per the college's leadership page and Wikipedia. Start date, prior role, and predecessor could not be confirmed - news searches for her appointment returned no results during this research.

records.name: Susan Rogers
records.notes: Confirmed as current president via CMCC's official Administration & Governance page. Wikipedia's infobox (likely stale) lists a different, earlier name (Betsy H. Libby) as president; that appears to be a predecessor rather than the current officeholder, but the transition date and order could not be confirmed via available news sources. Start date and prior role for Rogers not confirmed.

records.name: Jesse Smith
records.notes: Current president. The college's site hosts downloadable 'President's Reports' spanning 2017-2021, indicating he was already president by 2017. Exact start date and predecessor could not be confirmed via available news sources.

records.name: Mel Ponder
records.notes: Current president per Wikipedia. The college's official website (nwfsc.edu) blocked automated access (403 Forbidden) throughout this research, and news searches did not surface his appointment date, prior role, or predecessor.

records.name: Lane Glenn
records.notes: Current president, confirmed via the college's leadership page and recent 2026 news coverage (Salem News, Eagle-Tribune). Exact start date and predecessor could not be confirmed via available sources during this research.

records.name: Keith Flamer
records.priorTitle: Vice President of Instruction and Student Development / VP for Student Services
records.notes: 7th President/Superintendent of CR since 2015 (indicating six prior presidents, whose names were not confirmed via available sources). Before rising internally to VP roles at CR, he was Assistant VP for Learning and Student Support Services and Executive Dean of Enrollment at McHenry County College (IL). As of this research, the Redwoods Community College District has launched a nationwide search for his successor, with three finalists (Dr. Thad Russell, Dr. David Williams, Dr. Mark C. Fields) named; Flamer remains the sitting president pending that search's conclusion.
